candidate_reports.remark: Delayed report relayed via emergency management. 911 received two calls that a control unit had blown off of the water tower in Humboldt.
Delayed report relayed via emergency management. Downed power line caused lawn and fence to catch fire at a residence in central Humboldt.
Delayed report relayed via emergency manager. Caller reported a utility pole snapped off on Arizona Rd between 2400 St and 2600 St.
Delayed report of tree damage in west Wichita near 119th and Pawnee.
Multiple reports of power lines down in town.
Widespread street flooding across Iola. Some lanes are closed due to deep water_ and some streets are impassible with smaller vehicles.
Some flooding of typical flood-prone areas in and around Cherryvale.
Report of a tree down partially in the roadway on the south side of Iola.
Strong winds knocked down a large tree limb.
ASOS station KCNU Chanute Martin Johnson Airport.
Local dispatch reported power outages and several tree branches down around town.
Delayed report. Several trees branches down around the county. Additionally_ a couple of utility poles were knocked down near Galesburg. Time estimated by radar.
Delayed report_ time estimated from radar and observations. Large panels of a 70 foot wall at a Boeing/Spirit plant were ripped off. Courtesy of KSN TV. Reported by Sedgwick County Emergency Manageme
